## Episode Thesis

This Danish consumer-finance episode is about cutting household heating and electricity bills this winter. Realdania building expert Thue Patursson covers turning the thermostat down (about 5% saved per degree), shorter showers, radiator placement and venting, window seals, energy labels, and replacing gas or oil boilers with district heating or heat pumps. No listed equities or investment views are discussed. The only market-related remarks are warnings of an expensive winter for natural-gas heating and that new grid tariffs make evening peak-hour power costlier.
